decisions.reason: Durand (2016) conducts an empirical replication and Dark Triad extension of Dussault, Hojjat, and Boone (2013; doi:10.2224/sbp.2013.41.2.283) in a new sample of 106 community participants. For the original study's findings, the author explicitly states an overall verdict of partial replication: the positive association between Machiavellianism and deceptive mating strategies (DMS) (as well as correlations between Machiavellianism and gender, and between perceptions of intimacy [PI] and history of intimate behaviors [HIB]) was confirmed, whereas the previously reported negative associations between PI and Machiavellianism and between PI and DMS were not supported. Both shipped and blind codings accurately record the outcome as 'mixed'.
